title: worca.flow
description: Declarative pipeline flow specification (W-070). Describes the ordered stage list and outcome-driven transitions, including loops with counters and limits. Semantic validation (goto targets, cycle bounds, file existence) is enforced by worca.orchestrator.flow.load_flow at launch.

stages.description: Ordered stage list. Order is the linear-advance order; 'on' transitions jump within it.

name.description: Stage key. Becomes the status.json stages.* key verbatim.

agent.description: Agent template name. Default: builtin map lookup for builtin stage names, else the stage name.

schema.description: Structured-output schema filename under .claude/worca/schemas/. Default: builtin map lookup, else '{name}.json'.

prompt_block.description: Stage block .block.md name. Default: builtin map lookup, else the stage name.

enabled.description: Same semantics as worca.stages.<name>.enabled. Default: per-stage builtin default (plan_review and learn default disabled, everything else enabled), overridable via worca.stages config.

post.description: Runs after the terminal transition (today: learn). Post stages cannot be jump targets.

outputs.description: Declared stage outputs (W-072): output name -> JSON pointer into the stage's validated schema result. The executor publishes each value as stages.<name>.<output> in the prompt context after schema validation. Pointers are validated against the schema's properties at launch.

on.description: Map of outcome trigger -> transition. Absence of a matching trigger means 'advance to the next stage in the list'.

goto.description: Target stage name. Must name an enabled, non-post stage.

loop.description: Loop counter key; limit from worca.loops.<key> (default 5). Required for backward/self jumps (unbounded cycles are rejected). Must not collide with the reserved per-stage '<name>_iteration' counters.
